data: Pendant huit ans, Judith Abitbol a filmé dans son village, en Italie, Ede Bartolozzi. Pendant huit années, elle filme ce qui est en train de disparaître. Ede et Paola, sa fille, étaient liées par un amour extraordinaire. Ce film raconte cet amour-là, dans ce village, avec la famille, les amis, les voisins. Les étreintes des corps, les visages et les mains. Il témoigne de ce qui restera : l’immense joie de vivre et d’avoir aimé. (For eight years, Judith Abitbol filmed in her village, Ede Bartolozzi, in Italy. For eight years she has filmed what was disappearing. Ede and Paola, her daughter, were bound by an extraordinary love. This film recounts this love, in this village, with family, friends, neighbors. Bodies embracing, faces, hands. It witnesses what will remain: an immense joy in living and of having loved.)

For eight years, Judith Abitbol filmed in her village, Ede Bartolozzi, in Italy. For eight years she has filmed what was disappearing. Ede and Paola, her daughter, were bound by an extraordinary love. This film recounts this love, in this village, with family, friends, neighbors. Bodies embracing, faces, hands. It witnesses what will remain: an immense joy in living and of having loved.
